$comment: ★★ A LINKED OBJECT'S `/SECTION:` SETS A SECTION'S ATTRIBUTES (P69 round 4, D-LK-COFF-READER-SKIPPED-EVERY-LINKER-DIRECTIVE). The archive's one member is cl 19.44's `/c /O2 /MD /GS-` build of `#pragma comment(linker, "/SECTION:.rdata,RW")`, a `const int dss_rdata_table[4]` and `dss_rdata_poke`, which writes 40 into the table through a volatile pointer and reads it back. The table lives in `.rdata`, so the write faults in an image whose `.rdata` is read-only. main.c first reads `.rdata`'s Characteristics back from its own image (2 if not writable, 3 if not readable, 4 if there is no `.rdata`), then returns the poke's 40 + 2. ✔MEASURED 2026-10-07, and again on this fixture as rebuilt 2026-10-08: the same main.c built by cl and linked against this archive runs to 42 under link.exe 14.44 and lld-link 19.1.5. The `release` arm pins that optimizing the DSS half leaves the foreign write where it is.
